name: delegation
description: Delegation machinery: /delegate routes a task shape to the right specialist from the HOST's own agent roster (live model lookup, no hardcoded table), and /create-new-sub-agent mints the specialist when none fits — template + linter included. Also ships a PreToolUse hook that denies the general-purpose subagent and points at /delegate. Ships the router, the guard and the rule for making agents, never the agents.
